title.ko: 예술 비평: evoke · convey · juxtapose · a sense of · be reminiscent of
title.en: arts criticism and aesthetics: evoke, convey, juxtapose, a sense of, be reminiscent of

explain.ko: 예술 비평은 작품의 효과, 기법, 의미를 묘사하고 평가하는 글입니다. 효과는 evoke, convey, arouse, 기법은 juxtapose, contrast, employ, 연상은 be reminiscent of, echo, recall로 표현합니다. 해석은 단정하기보다 may suggest, can be read as 같은 헤징을 사용하고, open to interpretation으로 열린 해석을 인정합니다. 평가는 구체적인 요소(composition, colour, symbolism)와 함께 서술하세요.
explain.en: Arts criticism describes and evaluates a work's effect, technique and meaning. Effect uses evoke, convey, arouse; technique uses juxtapose, contrast, employ; association uses be reminiscent of, echo, recall. For interpretation, hedge (may suggest, can be read as) and acknowledge open to interpretation. Tie evaluation to concrete elements (composition, colour, symbolism).
